integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Ultra-photorealistic live-action cinematic surrealism. Begin by matching the exact final composition of the previous segment: a medium over-the-shoulder view from behind the Cleaner at the apartment doorway, the Cleaner occupying the left foreground and the Young Woman seated on the sofa in the right-middle background, with warm afternoon daylight glowing through the balcony doors. Beige speckled tile flooring, slightly aged off-white walls, low white ceiling, simple 4000K LED ceiling fixture, fabric sofa and wooden coffee table remain exactly consistent. The camera remains completely static for the first two seconds with no dialogue. During this airlock buffer, the Cleaner — matching <Picture 1> exactly: black hair swept back into a neat low bun, softly rounded oval face with visible natural smile lines, pale blue-gray housekeeping jacket with a dark gray stand collar and dark gray cuffs, dark gray waist apron, loose navy work pants, black lace-up work shoes, a blue cleaning cloth tucked at the left hip and pale yellow rubber gloves hanging from the right side of the apron, sturdy middle-aged build and warm, slightly breathless expression — lowers the mop from her shoulder by several centimeters, takes one quiet recovery breath and shifts her weight onto her right foot.

The Young Woman — matching <Picture 2> exactly: long dark-brown wavy hair worn half-up with a small beige claw clip and wispy bangs, small soft oval face, cream textured knit hoodie with front buttons and drawstrings, loose cream drawstring pants, cream fluffy house slippers, slim relaxed build and gentle amused expression — lightly scrolls once with her right thumb, blinks naturally and raises her eyes toward the Cleaner. No one speaks before 00:02.000.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow speed into a natural medium two-shot beside the sofa. A middle-aged Chinese female voice in standard Mandarin, warm and slightly husky, now recovering from the climb and speaking at a brisk, friendly working-class conversational rate (S1), smiles politely and says: <d>[Chinese] 姑娘你忙你的，我擦个阳台就走。</d> She gestures gently toward the balcony with the mop and keeps a respectful distance.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.900, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the Young Woman. A young Chinese female voice in standard Mandarin, light, clear and relaxed, with an easy friendly tone and brisk short-video conversational rhythm (S2), lifts the smartphone slightly and says: <d>[Chinese] 姐你歇会儿，我正用红果短剧看漫剧呢，你要不要也瞅瞅？</d> Her smile becomes more inviting. The phone screen briefly catches warm window reflections while remaining readable.

At approximately 00:07.000, the camera arcs gently with small amplitude toward the Cleaner, forming a loose two-shot with the Young Woman still visible at frame edge. The Cleaner chuckles softly, looks at the phone and answers at a deliberately accelerated but articulate short-video pace: <d>[Chinese] 我平时干完活也刷红果短剧。</d> The smartphone naturally displays a clean entertainment-app interface with the visible header "红果短剧"; no oversized advertising graphics appear. The segment ends on a stable medium two-shot: Cleaner standing on the left beside the sofa, Young Woman seated on the right holding the phone between them, both looking toward the screen.

overall_soundscape: Soft domestic room ambience continues from the previous segment, including distant traffic, faint refrigerator hum, quiet clothing rustle and the soft thump of the mop being set more vertically beside the Cleaner. A subtle sofa cushion compression sound accompanies the Young Woman shifting her posture. Phone interface taps are crisp but quiet; no extra intelligible phone audio competes with the dialogue.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Ultra-photorealistic live-action cinematic surrealism, with physically realistic human anatomy, natural skin pores, highly detailed fabric fibers, believable lighting and motion, combined with subtly heightened depth, gentle dreamlike highlight bloom, and slightly exaggerated spatial perspective. A medium-wide tracking shot follows a narrow stairwell inside an aging Chinese residential building: worn gray terrazzo steps, slightly yellowed off-white walls, exposed utility pipes, old metal handrails, a low concrete ceiling, and warm 3500K wall lamps creating soft pools of light. The enclosed stairwell has a dry, noticeable echo. The camera tracks backward at normal walking speed as the Cleaner — matching <Picture 1> exactly: black hair swept back into a neat low bun, softly rounded oval face with visible natural smile lines, pale blue-gray housekeeping jacket with a dark gray stand collar and dark gray cuffs, dark gray waist apron, loose navy work pants, black lace-up work shoes, a blue cleaning cloth tucked at the left hip and pale yellow rubber gloves hanging from the right side of the apron, sturdy middle-aged build and warm, slightly breathless expression — climbs the final flight toward the sixth floor while carrying a mop over one shoulder. Her shoulders rise and fall heavily from exertion. A middle-aged Chinese female voice in standard Mandarin, warm and slightly husky, audibly breathy from climbing six flights, speaking in a fast but natural social-video storytelling rhythm (S1), looks briefly toward the camera and says: <d>[Chinese] 宝子们，今天这单是老小区六楼，没电梯，我扛着拖把爬上来，喘得跟拉风箱似的。</d> The camera shakes slightly with small amplitude to preserve a realistic handheld documentary feeling while every facial detail remains photorealistic.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.100, the camera cuts to a shoulder-height tracking shot as the Cleaner reaches the apartment doorway, pushes open the slightly worn wooden door and steps inside. The interior is a modest sixth-floor living room with beige speckled tile flooring, slightly aged off-white walls, a low white ceiling with a simple 4000K round LED fixture, a fabric sofa beside a small wooden coffee table, and warm 5200K afternoon daylight entering through large sliding balcony doors. The light creates a subtle surreal glow around dust particles floating near the balcony while remaining physically realistic. The Cleaner continues seamlessly across the cut: <d>[Chinese] 推门一看，这家小姑娘正窝在沙发上用手机看剧，我怕打扰就先打了个招呼。</d> The camera slowly pushes in with small amplitude as her gaze moves toward the sofa.

The Young Woman becomes visible on the sofa — matching <Picture 2> exactly: long dark-brown wavy hair worn half-up with a small beige claw clip and wispy bangs, small soft oval face, cream textured knit hoodie with front buttons and drawstrings, loose cream drawstring pants, cream fluffy house slippers, slim relaxed build and gentle amused expression — sitting comfortably with her legs relaxed and a smartphone held naturally in both hands. She remains focused on the phone and does not speak. The Cleaner pauses beside the doorway with the mop still resting against her shoulder. The segment ends on a medium over-the-shoulder composition from behind the Cleaner at the doorway, with the Cleaner occupying the left foreground and the Young Woman seated on the sofa in the right-middle background, the bright balcony doors behind her. Hold this exact composition for the final half-second.

overall_soundscape: Natural stairwell reverberation, rapid footsteps climbing terrazzo stairs, the soft tapping of the mop handle against the railing, clothing friction and the Cleaner's clearly audible heavy breathing establish the opening. After the door opens, the acoustics become softer and more domestic, with faint refrigerator hum, distant neighborhood traffic through the balcony and subtle sofa-fabric movement. Phone playback is present only as an extremely low, indistinct electronic murmur with no additional intelligible dialogue.
